stem: An associate asks Claude to summarize a new regulation, and Claude produces a confident summary citing a specific subsection number. Before sending the summary to the compliance team, what is the most appropriate action?

options.text: Send it as-is, since Claude expressed high confidence.
Verify the cited subsection against the official regulation text before sharing.
Ask Claude to rate its own confidence and send it if the rating is high.
Reword the summary to sound more formal, then send it.

explanation: Language models can fabricate specific-looking details such as citation numbers, a hallucination. Validating factual claims, especially citations bound for a compliance audience, against an authoritative source is the diligence step required.

distractors.A: Self-reported confidence is not a reliable accuracy signal.
distractors.C: A self-rated confidence score is still not a reliable accuracy signal.

stem: An associate needs to generate a high volume of short customer-reply drafts where speed and cost matter more than deep reasoning. Which choice best fits the task?

options.text: Use the most capable, highest-cost model for every reply to maximize quality.
Use a faster, lower-cost model suited to straightforward, high-volume tasks.
Disable all product features to reduce cost.
Switch to a different AI platform.

explanation: Aligning model selection with task requirements means matching a faster, lower-cost model to straightforward, high-volume work, reserving the most capable model for complex reasoning.

distractors.A: Always using the top model wastes the cost and latency budget.
distractors.C: Disabling features does not address the trade-off.
distractors.D: Switching platforms does not address the trade-off.

stem: A project manager wants to upload a spreadsheet containing customer names and account numbers so Claude can analyze trends. Organizational policy restricts sharing regulated personal data. What is the most appropriate action?

options.text: Upload the file as-is, since the analysis is internal.
Remove or anonymize the personal identifiers before uploading, consistent with policy.
Upload the file but instruct Claude not to retain it.

explanation: Applying data-sensitivity and privacy safeguards means redacting or anonymizing regulated identifiers before use, so the analysis can proceed without exposing protected data.

distractors.C: Instructing the model not to retain data does not satisfy the policy control.
distractors.D: Abandoning the task is unnecessary when anonymization enables it.
